notes.title: Progress update!
notes.content:
Hi all! This is programmer psy_wombats here with a brief update on where we're at.

First of all, apologies for the radio silence the past couple months -- we've been concentrating on responding to feedback from our beta testers instead of new features, and bugfixing and balancing are a bit less glamorous than new features. The good news is that we're finally done with our design pass and starting in the last quality-of-life features, animations, and sprites.

First up, we're working on special battle animations for each boss and for high-level magic attacks. Hopefully these should give bosses a bit of flair, and lend a sense of accomplishment to unlocking the strongest magic. Here's a few we're proud of, first for RIME, second for VORTEX:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43816418/f7a74ec7dd18b338dd8a10c2d42f122e66070e67.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43816418/24862daf6c1778020c7bdbc54c04d47984465c48.gif[/img]

We've also been working on a lot of interface improvements to make some of the older-school mechanics easier to understand. For example, we've added visual indicators for groups of enemies, so that when there are three skeletons on the field, you actually see three skeletons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43816418/9e15bf87d3f42e7c078192981d8d1fad973670b9.png[/img]

Apart from that, we've been working on a plethora of polish, like improved controller support, menu overhauls, more speed options, hints, autosaves, etc etc -- basically every convenience players should expect from a modern RPG. While we've certainly been taking more time than we'd like to on these items, hopefully the extra shine will show in the final build. This game is a labor of love and we're all really looking forward to getting it out there.

Anyway! Thanks for following Secret of Varonis and bearing with us as we push towards a final release!
